header-desc: Decode Shenzhen. Connect the Future. Your digital survival guide for APEC.
ai-planner-desc: Tap to customize your tech & culture tour with Gemini AI.
ar-decoder-desc: Translate menus & signs with cultural context.
connected-desc: eSIM setup & airport Wi-Fi without SMS.
drone-desc: Experience Meituan drone delivery at Talent Park.
robotaxi-desc: Guide to fully autonomous rides in Nanshan.
tab-route-desc: Manage your curated tech safaris and local experiences during the summit.
tab-profile-desc: APEC 2026 Delegate • Manage your preferences, privacy, and safety settings.
tab-leader-desc: Discover the most popular check-in locations among APEC delegates.
lang-prompt: Select your preferred language for the Nexus interface and AI translation outputs.
ai-concierge-desc: Ask anything about Shenzhen or APEC.
hire-guide-desc: Enhance your tour with a bilingual local expert.
leader-fusion-desc: Every destination now carries dining, concierge, and pass-ready merchants nearby.
leader-fusion-tip: Tap any spot to see a business-break route, nearby merchants, and premium services.
ai-concierge-prompt: Ask me about Shenzhen weather, business etiquette, transportation, or APEC schedules.
ai-concierge-placeholder: e.g., How do I exchange business cards in China?
ai-planner-time: How much time do you have?
ai-planner-interest: What do you want to see?
ai-planner-placeholder: e.g., I want to visit DJI Sky City and eat spicy hotpot for dinner...
pay-tip-desc: Set this up before arriving in China to ensure you can receive SMS verification codes from your overseas bank.
pay-step1-desc: Use your home country phone number.
pay-step2-desc: Go to Account > Settings > Real-name Verification. Scan your passport.
pay-step3-desc: Go to Me > Bank Cards. Add your Visa, Mastercard, or JCB.
pay-w-step1-desc: Register for WeChat first. You may need a friend to verify your account.
pay-w-step2-desc: Go to Me > Services > Wallet > Cards to add your foreign credit card.
mob-map-desc: Google Maps data is inaccurate in mainland China. Use Apple Maps for accurate walking and public transit directions in English.
mob-emer-desc: Play these AI-generated native phrases to your driver if you can't find the pickup point.
mob-p1-en: I am waiting at the ride-hailing pickup area.
mob-p2-en: Please come to the underground parking (B1).
conn-restrict-desc: Google, WhatsApp, Instagram, and X are blocked in mainland China without a VPN or roaming data.
conn-s1-desc: Buying a travel eSIM before you arrive means you instantly have unfiltered internet upon landing. No VPN required.
conn-s2-desc: Most public Wi-Fi in China requires a Chinese phone number to receive a verification SMS. To get online at Shenzhen Airport:
conn-s2-l1: Find a "Wi-Fi Password Kiosk" near information desks.
conn-s2-l2: Scan the photo page of your passport on the machine.
conn-s2-l3: It will print a ticket with a PIN code to connect.
ar-upload-desc: Upload or take a photo of Chinese menus, signs, or text.
drone-desc-full: Experience the future of logistics. Order coffee or snacks and a drone will drop it at a designated kiosk in Shenzhen Talent Park within 15 mins.
drone-s1-desc: Walk to the designated drone landing kiosk near the south entrance of Talent Park.
drone-s2-desc: Open Alipay → Search "Meituan" → Select a nearby cafe → Choose "Drone Delivery" at checkout.
drone-s3-desc: When the drone arrives, scan the QR code on the kiosk screen to unlock your order.
robo-desc: Shenzhen is one of the first cities in the world to allow fully driverless taxis on public roads.
robo-s1-desc: Download Apollo Go or Pony.ai from the App Store. Register with your passport number.
robo-s2-desc: Robotaxis operate in designated zones in Nanshan and Qianhai. Set your pickup within these areas.
robo-s3-desc: The car will arrive with no driver. Enter using the app, confirm your trip, and enjoy the ride.
